name: cache-timer
description: Count down to when the session's prompt cache entry expires, on whichever surfaces you pick

ttl.title: Cache timer: TTL
ttl.description: auto reads the TTL of the last cache write from the transcript; 5m or 1h fixes it

showStatus.title: Cache timer: status line
showStatus.description: Show the countdown in the plugin status line under the prompt

showBand.title: Cache timer: band above prompt
showBand.description: Show a row above the prompt; takes the band from other mods while on

showHint.title: Cache timer: hint line
showHint.description: Append the countdown to the dim hint line under the prompt (terminal only)

showMode.title: Cache timer: footer mode label
showMode.description: Add the countdown to the mode labels at the right of the prompt footer

showSpinner.title: Cache timer: spinner
showSpinner.description: Add the countdown after the spinner word while a turn runs

showDuration.title: Cache timer: turn duration line
showDuration.description: Add when the cache stays warm until to the line closing each turn

showPane.title: Cache timer: pane
showPane.description: Keep a pane open with the countdown

showToast.title: Cache timer: expiry toasts
showToast.description: Toast a minute before the cache expires and again when it does
